overview: The 2026 manual adds major new rules around distracted and impaired driving, including the Hands-Free Mobile Phone Law, a full mobile-device ban for drivers under 18, ignition interlock requirements, and tougher OUI and chemical-test-refusal penalties. It also significantly expands protections for vulnerable road users, with new content on the four-foot bicycle passing rule, the Dutch Reach, separated bike lanes and bicycle boxes, the Move-Over Law, crossing guards, and roundabouts. Licensing has changed too, so review the REAL ID versus Standard ID choice, the revised Junior Operator curfew and training hours, the new online and audio exam options, the 14-day road test retake wait, and updated fees. Finally, watch for newer driving topics such as Advanced Driver Assistance Systems, recommended car safety kits, proper backing-up technique, tunnel and breakdown safety procedures, and updated child restraint, following-distance, and snow-removal requirements.

sections.title: REAL ID and Standard Massachusetts Cards
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the federal REAL ID system requiring customers to choose between a REAL ID and Standard Massachusetts license or ID card.
bullets: "You need to choose either a REAL ID Massachusetts Driver's License or ID Card or a Standard Massachusetts Driver's License or ID Card." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You need a REAL ID, or other acceptable ID such as a valid passport, to fly within the United States or enter certain federal buildings." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Night Curfew Time
sections.description: The Junior Operator night driving restriction start time changed from 12:00 a.m. to 12:30 a.m.
bullets: "As the holder of a JOL, you may not operate a motor vehicle between 12:30 a.m. and 5:00 a.m. unless you are accompanied by one of your parents or your legal guardian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Passenger and Night Restriction Penalties
sections.description: Penalties for violating the JOL passenger or night restriction changed to 60 days first offense, 180 days second, and one year for subsequent offenses, with a required retraining course.
bullets: "If you violate the passenger restriction or the night restriction, you will be subject to a license suspension of 60 days for a first offense, 180 days for a second offense, and one year for subsequent offenses." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"For a second or subsequent offense, you will also be required to complete a Driver Attitudinal Retraining course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Driver Education and Supervised Driving Hours
sections.description: The required in-car behind-the-wheel training and supervised driving hours increased, and new parent/guardian instruction and final exam requirements were added.
bullets: "Successfully complete an RMV-approved driver education and training program, which includes 30 hours of classroom instruction; 12 hours of in-car, behind-the-wheel training; and six hours of in-car experience observing other student drivers." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Complete at least an additional 40 hours of supervised, behind-the­ wheel driving as shown by a certified statement provided by a parent or guardian." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"A parent or guardian must participate in two hours of instruction on the driver's education curriculum (unless they have participated within the past five years)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: JOL Drag Racing and Speeding Suspension Periods
sections.description: Suspension periods for JOL drag racing and speeding offenses were changed to specific durations.
bullets: "You will face additional suspension periods of one year for a first drag racing offense and three years for a subsequent offense. For a first speeding offense, you will be suspended for 90 days; for a subsequent offense, you will be suspended for one year." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Mobile Device Ban for Drivers Under 18
sections.description: The 2026 manual prohibits drivers under 18 from using any mobile electronic device while operating a motor vehicle.
bullets: "Drivers under 18 may not use any mobile electronic device for" "any reason while operating a motor vehicle . The only exception is for reporting an emergency." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers under 18 cannot use any mobile electronic device for any reason while driving. The only exception is for reporting an emergency." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Facial Image Policy - Eyeglasses Prohibited
sections.description: The facial image policy was changed to prohibit eyeglasses in photos, whereas the 2004 manual allowed reading and prescription glasses if normally worn.
bullets: "Eyeglasses, including reading or prescription glasses, are not allowed, even if the applicant normally wears them." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Bluetooth headsets are not acceptable." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: State-to-State Program / One License Rule
sections.description: The 2026 manual describes Massachusetts participation in the State-to-State program preventing holding licenses in multiple states.
bullets: "Massachusetts is part of the State-to-State program, which checks valid driver licenses and state issued ID cards issued by other participating states." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You cannot hold a driver's license in multiple states." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-Country Driver Section 10 Penalty
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a criminal violation and $500 fine for violating Chapter 90 Section 10 regarding foreign license operation.
bullets: "A violation of Section 10 is a criminal violation and a first offense is subject to a fine of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vertical License/ID for Under 21
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces a vertical-format license or ID card for those under age 21.
bullets: "If you renew your license or ID card before your 21st birthday, you will receive a vertical license or ID card ." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Learner's Permit Exam Structure
sections.description: The exam now has 25 questions requiring 18 correct in 25 minutes, increased from 20 questions requiring 14 correct in 20 minutes.
bullets: "Each learner’s permit exam has 25 multiple-choice questions." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"To pass the exam, you must answer 18 questions correctly within the allotted time of 25 minutes." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-State Vehicle Insurance Minimums for Road Test
sections.description: The minimum insurance coverage limits for out-of-state vehicles used in the road test increased from $20,000/$40,000 bodily injury and $5,000 property damage to $25,000/$50,000 bodily injury and $30,000 property damage.
bullets: "you must show the examiner proof of insurance coverage equal to Massachusetts minimum limits, which are $25,000/$50,000 for bodily injury and $30,000 for property damage." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Supervised Driving Hours for Driver's Education
sections.description: Required supervised driving increased from 12 hours to 40 hours (30 hours if a driver skills development program is completed), and parents/guardians must now participate in two hours of curriculum.
bullets: "You must also complete 40 hours of supervised driving (30 hours if you completed a driver skills development program), and your parent or guardian must participate in two hours of the driver’s education curriculum (unless he/she already attended in the past five years)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Cancellation/Reschedule Notice
sections.description: The notice period to cancel or reschedule a road test without a fee changed from more than 24 hours to more than 72 hours.
bullets: "There is no additional fee if you cancel or reschedule with more than 72 hours notice." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Testing Accommodations for Disabilities
sections.description: The 2026 edition adds reasonable accommodation options including extended time and a designated reader for cognitive or physical disabilities.
bullets: "If you have a cognitive or physical disability that would prevent you from taking a standard exam, you may request a reasonable accommodation, which could include: • Extended time • Reader" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: SSN Denial Notice Documentation Requirements
sections.description: The 2026 edition adds specific additional documentation required with an SSN Denial Notice, including I-94 record, current visa status, and current non-U.S. passport, plus a No Social Security Number Affidavit option.
bullets: "If you have applied for an SSN with the SSA and been denied, you must present the written Denial Notice (not more than 60 days old) the SSA provided you and all of the following: • Proof of your current visa status • An I-94 Record of Arrival & Departure" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you do not have an SSN and cannot apply for one, you can present a No Social Security Number Affidavit and apply for a Standard Driver's License" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Audio Exams
sections.description: The 2026 edition introduces audio exams available through ATS and online that read questions and answers aloud through headphones in multiple languages.
bullets: "Audio exams are available through the ATS and for online exams. This feature allows you to hear an automated voice read the test questions and possible answers through headphones." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Online Learner's Permit Exam
sections.description: The 2026 edition allows the learner's permit exam to be taken online after submitting an application at a service center.
bullets: "They are also available online at Mass.Gov/RMV after you submit your application." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Failure Waiting Period
sections.description: The 2026 edition introduces a mandatory 14-day waiting period before retaking a road test after failing or not appearing.
bullets: "If you fail a road test or do not appear for your scheduled test, you must wait at least 14 days before taking another test." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rejected Road Tests for Impairment
sections.description: The 2026 edition adds specific grounds for rejecting a road test, including signs of alcohol/substance impairment, odor of alcohol or cannabis, and presence of unsupervised children or animals.
bullets: "An odor of alcohol or cannabis is coming from you or your sponsor, including from clothing or inside the vehicle" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking Brake Requirement for Road Test
sections.description: The 2026 edition requires an accessible parking brake (manual or electric) for the examiner's emergency stop and adds a specific RPM-based parking brake test, replacing the prior foot brake or emergency hand brake requirement.
bullets: "An accessible parking brake so the examiner can make an emergency stop. The parking brake can be manual or electric (push or pull button)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Massachusetts regulation 540 CMR 4.04 (4) requires that parking brakes be tested by accelerating the motor to 1,200 to 1,300 RPMs with the vehicle in the lowest gear." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Donut Tire Prohibition for Road Test
sections.description: The 2026 edition prohibits using a vehicle with a limited-use spare (donut) tire for the road test.
bullets: "A vehicle cannot be used for a road test if one of its tires has been replaced by a \"donut\" (limited use spare) tire." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Sponsor Frequency Limit
sections.description: The 2026 edition limits operators to sponsoring no more than three different applicants within a one-year period without RMV approval.
bullets: "Operators are not allowed to sponsor more than three different applicants within a one year period without approval from the RMV Road Test Program." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Class M Road Test Restriction for Under 18
sections.description: The 2026 edition states that applicants under 18 are not eligible for an RMV Class M road test and must complete the MREP basic rider course.
bullets: "If you are under 18 years old, you are not eligible for an RMV Class M road test and must complete the MREP basic rider course to get a Class M license." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Specialized Vehicle Features During Road Test
sections.description: The 2026 edition addresses modern specialized features (backup cameras, automatic parallel parking, GPS) during the road test and adds a mechanical/software aid restriction.
bullets: "These devices will not need to be disabled. However, your driving skills and abilities without relying only on these specialized features will be tested." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Electronic Device Prohibition During Exam
sections.description: The 2026 edition prohibits wearing or using any electronic device (including electronic optical devices) during the learner's permit exam, with cheating penalties.
bullets: "You also are not allowed to wear or use any electronic device (including electronic optical devices), regardless of the purpose of the device." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Service Animals During Road Test
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules permitting trained service animals but prohibiting emotional support animals in the vehicle during a road test.
bullets: "Trained service animals are allowed in the vehicle, but emotional support animals are not." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Cancellation Notice Period
sections.description: The notice required to cancel a road test without being charged increased from 24 hours to 72 hours.
bullets: "are rejected by the examiner, or cancel your appointment with less than 72 hours notice, you will still be charged the $35 fee" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Road Test Fee
sections.description: The road test/license application fee increased from $20 to $35.
bullets: "The RMV charges a flat fee for any license application. This fee covers the cost of processing your application and scheduling a road test." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Road test fee - $35.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Issue/Renew Fee
sections.description: The driver's license issuance fee increased from $40 to $50 for Class D and Class M.
bullets: "License issue/renew fee - Class D - $50.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"License issue/renew fee - Class M - $50.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Duplicate or Amended License Fee
sections.description: The fee to add or change a restriction/amend a license changed from $15 (with $20 duplicate fee) to a flat $25.
bullets: "Duplicate or amended license - $25.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Temporary License Validity After Road Test
sections.description: The temporary license issued upon passing the road test is valid for up to 60 days, increased from up to 30 days in 2004.
bullets: "the examiner will validate your learner's permit and it will become a temporary license, valid up to 60 days" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Supervised Driving Hours for Junior Operator Conversion
sections.description: The required supervised behind-the-wheel driving hours increased from an additional 12 hours to 40 hours (30 hours with a driver skills development program).
bullets: "you must log an additional 40 hours of supervised driving (30 hours if you completed a driver skills development program) as shown by a certified statement provided by a parent or guardian" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Deaf and Hard of Hearing Road Tests
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a detailed procedure for scheduling road tests and arranging interpreters for deaf or hard of hearing applicants.
bullets: "If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you can schedule a road test by calling 1-877-RMV-TTDD (1-877-768-8833)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Zero Tolerance Policy for Road Test Conduct
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a zero tolerance policy for violent or abusive conduct by road test applicants and sponsors.
bullets: "The RMV has a zero tolerance policy for violent or abusive conduct by road test applicants and sponsors." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Veteran's Indicator on License
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the ability to have the word 'Veteran' printed on a license or ID card.
bullets: "If you are a veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces and were honorably discharged, you can choose to have the word \"Veteran\" printed on your license or ID card." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Child Passenger Restraint Requirements
sections.description: The child restraint requirement changed from age 12/40 pounds in 2004 to at least eight years old or fifty-seven inches tall in 2026.
bullets: "Infants and small children must sit in federally approved child passenger restraints until they... 1. Are at least eight years old or 2. At least fifty-seven inches tall" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Car Safety Kits
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a recommended list of safety items to carry in the vehicle, including seasonal winter items.
bullets: "It is recommended to carry the following items in your vehicle: • Reflective Safety Vest • Reflective Warning Triangles or LED Flares • First Aid Kit • Glass Breaker Tool • White and red cloths to tie to your vehicle during a breakdown" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Hands-Free Mobile Phone Use
sections.description: The 2004 rule allowing cell phone use while keeping one hand on the wheel is replaced by a reference to a Hands-Free Mobile Phone Use law.
bullets: "For information on the use of mobile (cell) phones and other mobile electronic devices, see the Hands-Free Mobile (Cell) Phone Use section below." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headphones While Driving
sections.description: The headphone prohibition is expanded to cover wired or wireless devices and limits the single earplug exception to drivers 18 or older.
bullets: "It is illegal to wear a radio headset, headphones, or any other wired or wireless device that restricts your attention to the environment while driving. If you are 18 or older, you can use one earplug for use with a cell phone." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Loud Noise Inside Vehicle
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds guidance to avoid loud noise levels so emergency sirens can be heard.
bullets: "Avoid loud noise levels in your vehicle so you can hear emergency vehicle sirens." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Emergency Lights on Vehicle
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that emergency lights (flashing, rotating, oscillating, or strobe) are not allowed without an RMV permit.
bullets: "Emergency lights (flashing, rotating, oscillating, or strobe lights) are not allowed on a vehicle unless you get a permit from the RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Permanent License Mailing Time
sections.description: The follow-up period for a missing permanent license changed from 4 weeks to 30 days.
bullets: "If your permanent license does not arrive in the mail within 30 days, please call the RMV Contact Center." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Out-of-State Conversion Fees
sections.description: Out-of-state conversion fees and the motorcycle add-on fee structure changed in the 2026 manual.
bullets: "Class A* - $140.00 Class B* - $140.00 Class C* - $140.00 Class D* - $115.00" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"*To add motorcycle privileges (Class M) to any of these license classes, you must pay an additional $3.00 per year." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Hands-Free Mobile Electronic Device Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual prohibits hand-held mobile device use while driving, whereas the 2004 manual permitted cell phone use as long as one hand remained on the wheel.
bullets: "The use of hand-held mobile electronic devices (including cell phones) while driving is prohibited in Massachusetts (Chapter 90, Section 13B and Chapter 122 of the Acts of 2019)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers 18 and older can only use mobile electronic devices in “hands­free” mode while driving." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Penalties for Hand-Held Device Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual establishes specific escalating fines for using a hand-held mobile device while driving, which did not exist in 2004.
bullets: "1st offense - $100 fine" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"2nd offense - $250 fine, plus mandatory completion of a distracted driving educational program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"3rd and subsequent offenses - $500 fine, plus insurance surcharge and mandatory completion of a distracted driving program" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Vulnerable Road Users Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a Vulnerable Road Users Law requiring a four-foot passing distance, which does not exist in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "When you pass a vulnerable road user, you must leave a safe passing distance of at least four feet between your vehicle and the road user." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drowsy Driving
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a dedicated drowsy driving section with statistics and prevention guidance not present in 2004.
bullets: "The ONLY true way to protect yourself from drowsy driving is to get enough sleep and to not drive when you feel tired." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS)
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a section on Advanced Driver Assistance Systems, a topic absent from the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Many cars and trucks now come with Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). These can make driving safer, but only if used correctly." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Following Distance Rule
sections.description: The safe following distance rule was changed from a two-second rule in 2004 to a three-second rule in 2026.
bullets: "Use the "three-second" rule to keep a safe distance from the vehicle in front of you." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you reach the object before you count three, you are too close." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Plate Visibility Requirement
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific requirement that plate numbers be visible from 60 feet at night and kept clean and unobstructed.
bullets: "You must keep your license plates clean and they cannot be blocked by anything. Your plate number must be visible from 60 feet at night." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Snow and Ice Removal Penalty
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands the winter snow-removal requirement to include the roof, hood, and trunk and adds a negligent operation charge for failure to clear.
bullets: "It is very important that you clear the roof, hood, and trunk so ice and snow does not blow into vehicles behind you. If you do not, you can be charged with negligent operation." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Tailgating Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a fine of up to $100 for tailgating, which was not stated in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Tailgating is illegal and the main cause of rear-end crashes. The fine for tailgating can be as high as $100." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Headlight Use in Tunnels
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the requirement to use headlights while driving through a tunnel, which was not listed in the 2004 manual's headlight use situations.
bullets: "While driving through a tunnel" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motorized Scooter Safety
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces rules for operating motorized scooters, which do not appear in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "A motorized scooter is any two or three-wheeled vehicle with handlebars and an electric or gas motor that can move the vehicle with or without human propulsion." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Do not drive faster than 20 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You can be fined up to $25 (1st Offense); $25-$50 (2nd Offense); $50-$100 (3rd + Offense)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Limited Use Vehicle Safety
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a category for limited use vehicles not present in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "A limited use vehicle can have two or more wheels. It can go faster than 30 mph, but not more than 40 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You cannot drive a limited use vehicle on a limited-access or express state highway or any road with a speed limit faster than 40 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Low Speed Vehicle Safety
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a category for low speed vehicles (LSVs) not present in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "A Low Speed Vehicle (LSV) has four wheels and can only go between 20 and 25 mph. It must have a gross weight rating lower than 3,000 lbs." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You must have a valid Class D driver’s license or learner’s permit to drive a low speed vehicle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Safety Laws
sections.description: The 2026 manual describes updated bicycle safety laws giving police the ability to cite bicyclists and motorists, which is not in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "If a police officer sees a bicyclist commit a traffic violation, the officer can issue a citation the same way they would for a motorist." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Companies that rent bicycles must offer helmets that meet all safety requirements for renters." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Civil Citation Hearing Filing Fee and Surcharge
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a $25 hearing filing fee and a $5 public safety surcharge on civil motor vehicle infractions that are not in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Every fine for a CMVI that comes from Chapter 89 or 90 of the Massachusetts General Laws will have an added $5 public safety surcharge." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you request a hearing, you must pay a $25 filing fee to the RMV." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Retraining Course Trigger
sections.description: The 2026 manual lowers the threshold for mandatory driver retraining from five surchargeable events to three within a two-year period.
bullets: "If you get three or more surchargeable events on your driving record within a two-year period, you must complete the Massachusetts Driver Retraining Course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: At-Fault Crash Claim Threshold
sections.description: The 2026 manual raises the claim payment threshold for an at-fault crash from $500 to $1000 and adds a bodily injury threshold.
bullets: "Has paid more than $1000 for collision, limited collision, or damage to someone else’s property or has paid more than $1000 for bodily injury (if there is no collision or damage to someone else’s property over $1000 from the same incident)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Speeding Public Safety Surcharge
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a $5 public safety surcharge to speeding violations, changing the example fine total.
bullets: "The lowest penalty for driving above the speed limit is a $100 fine, plus an additional $5 public safety surcharge which is added to all speeding violations." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"$185 total fine" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Moped Learner's Permit Passenger Restriction
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a $100 fine for moped rule violations and adds electronic signal requirements not in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Use the correct electronic and hand signals before stopping or turning." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You can be fined up to $100 for a violation of any of these rules." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motorcycle Following Distance
sections.description: The 2026 manual changes the recommended following distance behind a motorcycle from four-second versus two-second to four-second versus three-second.
bullets: "Use a four- second following distance (compared to a three-second for other motor vehicles)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Junior Operator Mobile Electronic Device Penalties
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds suspension penalties for junior operators convicted of using a mobile electronic device while driving, which did not exist in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Conviction for the Use of a Mobile Electronic Device (text or phone) (c. 90, §8M) 60 days— first offense 180 days— second offense One year— subsequent offenses" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a criminal offense and suspension for negligent operation and injury resulting from mobile phone use, which is absent from the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Negligent Operation and Injury from Mobile Phone Use 60 days–One year $500" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Ignition Interlock Devices
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces a requirement for Ignition Interlock Devices for drivers with two or more OUI offenses, which is not mentioned in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "If you had two or more operating under the influence offenses and are eligible for a hardship license or for license reinstatement, you must have an Ignition Interlock Device. It must be attached to your motor vehicle at your expense." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Other Reasons for License Suspensions
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands the non-driving reasons for license suspension to include sex offender registration failures, drug trafficking convictions, income tax failures, and bad payments, beyond the child support and warrants listed in 2004.
bullets: "Have failed to register as a sex offender • Have been convicted of certain drug trafficking offenses • Have failed to pay Massachusetts income tax • Have made a bad payment to the RMV" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Suspension Periods for Refusing a Chemical Test
sections.description: The 2026 manual provides updated and detailed suspension periods for refusing a chemical test based on prior OUI offenses, which differ from and expand upon the 2004 framework.
bullets: "Drivers over age 21 No Prior OUI Offenses 180 days One Prior OUI Offense Three years Two Prior OUI Offenses Five years Three or More Prior OUI Offenses Lifetime" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: OUI Penalties Updated
sections.description: The 2026 manual changes the fine structures and adds minimum imprisonment periods for OUI convictions compared to the 2004 manual's maximum-only figures.
bullets: "Second Offense $600–$10,000 Minimum 30 days Maximum 2 1/2 years Two years" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motor Vehicle Homicide Suspension Period
sections.description: The 2026 manual changes the suspension period for motor vehicle homicide and adds vehicular manslaughter as a separate offense with a higher minimum suspension than the 2004 manual's 10 years.
bullets: "Motor vehicle homicide 15 years–Lifetime $500 Vehicular manslaughter 15 years–Lifetime $500" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Alcohol and Marijuana Combined Crash Risk
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific crash risk statistics for alcohol and combined alcohol-marijuana use that are not present in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Alcohol use makes the risk of a crash five times more likely. Alcohol use combined with marijuana use makes the risk of a crash twelve times more likely." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: License Nonrenewal for Toll Violations
sections.description: The 2026 manual expands the reasons for nonrenewal to include E-ZPass/Fast Lane violations in Maine and New Hampshire and Tobin Bridge violations, beyond what the 2004 manual listed.
bullets: "Unpaid Massachusetts, Maine, or New Hampshire E-ZPass/Fast Lane toll violations • Unpaid Tobin Bridge violations" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: State Courts Against Road Rage (SCARR) Course
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the SCARR course requirement for junior operators convicted of speeding or drag racing, which is not in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "In addition, you may be re quired to take a State Courts Against Road Rage (SCARR) course." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Pedestrian Injury Statistics by Speed
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific pedestrian injury and fatality statistics correlated to vehicle speed that are not present in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "At a speed of 20 mph, 13% of pedestrians are seriously injured or killed in a crash. At 30 mph, that increases to 40% and at 40 mph it increases to 73%." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: 25 mph Thickly Settled Speed Limit Option
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds that some communities have a thickly settled speed limit of 25 mph, which is not specified in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Some communities have a thickly settled speed limit of 25 mph unless posted otherwise (per M.G.L. c90, Section 17c). Signs are posted at all entrances to these cities and towns." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Boston Harbor Tunnel Minimum Speed
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a 20 mph minimum speed for the Boston Harbor tunnels, which is not mentioned in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "There is a minimum speed of 20 mph in the Boston Harbor tunnels (Callahan, Sumner, and Ted Williams)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drag Racing Penalty for Drivers Over 18
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a specific drag racing suspension and fine for drivers over age 18 in the criminal offenses table, which is not separately listed in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Drag racing (by drivers over the age of 18) 30 days-180 days $500 - $1,000" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Alcohol Highway Death Percentage
sections.description: The 2026 manual states alcohol causes about 30% of highway deaths, a change from the 2004 manual's statement that alcohol is responsible for half of all highway deaths.
bullets: "Each year in the United States, alcohol causes about 30% of all highway deaths." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Flashing Yellow Arrow Signal
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the flashing yellow arrow signal, which was not described in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "A flashing yellow arrow allows you to turn left or right in the direction of the arrow when oncoming traffic has a green light but there is a break in traffic. You must carefully determine that there is an adequate gap in the oncoming traffic and ensure that there are no pedestrians in your path before making your turn." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds rules for rectangular rapid flashing beacons, which did not exist in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons are activated by pedestrians manually by a push button or by a pedestrian detection system. They are often located in intersections without traffic signals or at mid-block crosswalks. When activated, amber lights flash in an irregular pattern. You must stop for pedestrians when the beacon is flashing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the pedestrian hybrid beacon, a feature absent from the 2004 manual.
bullets: "A Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB) allows pedestrians to safely cross a roadway. A PHB only operates when activated by a pedestrian. When all lights are dark, you can proceed with caution. When the bottom yellow light is flashing, you must slow down. When the bottom yellow light is solid, you must prepare to stop. When the top two red lights are solid, you must stop for pedestrians. When the top two red lights are flashing, you must stop and proceed with caution if clear." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Signals
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds bicycle-specific traffic signals, which were not mentioned in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle signals are lights specifically meant for bicyclists. They display as steady red, yellow, and green bicycle symbols. When the signal is green, bicyclists can go through busy intersections while motor vehicles are stopped, protecting them from turning vehicles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds detail about countdown timers in pedestrian signals not present in 2004.
bullets: "Some crosswalk signals include a numeric countdown timer. Pedestrians who are already in the crosswalk when the countdown reaches zero have the right-of-way." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Yielding to Pedestrians When Turning into Driveway
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds an explicit driver requirement to yield to pedestrians when turning into a driveway or parking lot.
bullets: "You must yield to pedestrians when turning into a driveway or parking lot." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Channelizing Islands
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces channelizing islands, which were not described in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "A channelizing island is a traffic island or pavement marking that guides traffic along certain paths and prevents operation on areas of the roadway. You cannot drive over or park a motor vehicle upon any channelizing island, unless directed to do so by a police officer." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Crossing Guards
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a section on crossing guards and how to recognize and respond to them, which was not in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "In recent years, several crossing guards in Massachusetts have been killed or injured while on duty when struck by vehicles. As a driver, you should look for warning signs that crossing guards and children may be in the road and be prepared to stop." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Shared Lane Markings (Sharrows)
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces shared lane markings, which were not present in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Shared Lane Markings (also known as Sharrows) help bicyclists position themselves in the right location and in the right direction in a lane that is shared with motor vehicles." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Lanes and Advisory Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds detailed descriptions of bicycle lanes and advisory bicycle lanes not found in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle lanes are portions of the roadway that are intended for use by bicyclists and are typically marked by solid white lines, along with pavement markings and signs. They are five feet wide. Motor vehicles may only drive in these lanes when turning on or off the road." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Advisory bicycle lanes are becoming common on streets that are too narrow for a full bicycle lane, but still have a lot of bicycle traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Green Pavement Markings
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces green pavement markings for bicycle conflict areas, not present in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Green pavement is used in areas where there could be road sharing conflicts between motor vehicles and bicycles. You should pay close attention and look for bicyclists before crossing green pavement. At a red light, you should not stop on green pavement." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bus Lanes (Red Pavement)
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces red pavement markings for transit lanes, not present in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Red pavement is used for travel lanes or station stops used by public transit systems. This includes buses, streetcars, trolleys, light-rail trains, and rapid transit fleets." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Yield Lines
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds yield line pavement markings, which were not described in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "An intersection with a yield sign may have a YIELD line painted across it. A YIELD line looks like a series of triangles painted next to each other." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Work Zone Traffic Control Devices and Flaggers
sections.description: The 2026 manual significantly expands work zone guidance, adding details on civil flaggers, arrow boards, detour signs, and channelizing devices not detailed in 2004.
bullets: "Civil Flaggers are typically used on low-speed, low-volume roadways to control traffic movement around the work area and to support other road users navigate the area." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You must always obey directions of a traffic officer, even when they overrule signs, signals, or pavement markings." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law
sections.description: A new law requires drivers to move over or slow down when approaching stationary emergency vehicles with flashing lights.
bullets: "The “move-over law” (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requires that if you are approaching a stationary emergency vehicle and it is displaying its flashing lights, you must proceed with caution and reduce your speed to that of a reasonable and safe speed for the road conditions." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Roundabouts
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a section on roundabouts, which were not covered in 2004.
bullets: "Roundabouts are similar to rotaries. They are generally much smaller than rotaries and have a smaller central barrier. Most roundabouts have yield lines on the pavement and crosswalks for pedestrians." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Three-Point Turns
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds instructions for performing three-point turns, not present in 2004.
bullets: "When there is not enough room for a U-turn, you may consider a three-point turn. This will put you in the opposite direction." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Courtesy Crashes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a section warning about courtesy crashes caused by waving drivers through.
bullets: "Sometimes, drivers trying to be nice can cause confusion resulting in "courtesy crashes". Waving people in through stopped traffic, or driving through traffic when someone waves you in, creates a dangerous situation and can easily result in a crash." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: School Bus Passing Penalty
sections.description: The penalty for a first violation of the school bus stopping law increased from up to $200 to a $250 fine.
bullets: "A first violation of this law can cause a license suspension and a $250 fine." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Funeral Processions
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a legal definition and specific right-of-way rules for funeral processions, citing M.G.L. Ch. 85, Section 14A.
bullets: "Funeral processions have the right-of-way at intersections, with the EXCEPTION that they must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens or when directed by law enforcement." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: White Cane Law for Blind Pedestrians
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the named White Cane Law and explicit prohibitions on honking or waving the person on.
bullets: "The White Cane Law states that a driver must come to a complete stop when a blind pedestrian is crossing a street." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Backing Up
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a step-by-step procedure for backing up that was not present in 2004.
bullets: "Position yourself as close as possible to the right edge of the curb. Check for traffic in both directions (including your blind spot). Shift into reverse and start backing up, while looking over your right shoulder." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driving in a Funeral Procession
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds detailed rules for both driving as part of a funeral procession and for vehicles encountering a procession, whereas the 2004 manual only stated drivers must yield to a procession.
bullets: "Not drive faster than 55 MPH on a highway with a speed limit of 55 MPH or higher. You must also not go more than 5 MPH slower than the speed limit on any other public way." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You may not pass a procession on a multiple lane highway on the procession's right, unless the procession is in the far left lane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking in a Bus Stop Fine
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies a $100 fine for parking in a posted bus stop, which was not stated in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "In a bus stop (the penalty for parking in a posted bus stop is $100)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: HP-DV Parking Violation Fines
sections.description: The 2026 manual specifies dollar-amount fines for HP-DV parking and plate misuse, whereas the 2004 manual only referred to a "heavy fine."
bullets: "The fine for a first offense is $300. The fine for wrongful use of a disabled person or veteran plate or placard is a minimum of $500." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Parking Prohibitions for Bicycle Lanes and Crosshatch Areas
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds new prohibited parking locations including bicycle lanes and striped crosshatch areas next to HP-DV spaces, plus a Massachusetts Turnpike fine range, none of which appear in the 2004 list.
bullets: "In a bicycle lane" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"In a striped crosshatch area next to an HP-DV space, even if you have disability plates or a placard" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"On the Massachusetts Turnpike (fines range from $15 - $100)" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicyclist Rules (Chapter 525 of the Acts of 2008)
sections.description: The 2026 manual greatly expands bicycle laws with detailed operational requirements, equipment rules, and side-by-side riding provisions far beyond the brief bicycle section in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "No more than two bicycles can be operated side-by-side. On a roadway with more than one lane in the direction of travel, bicyclists riding side-by-side must stay in one lane and not unnecessarily restrict a passing vehicle's ability to overtake you." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"You must have a proper working brake system to stop from 15 MPH within 30 feet." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"You must report any crash involving personal injury and any crash involving property damage in excess of $100 to the police in the municipality where it occurred." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Motorist Duties When Passing Bicycles
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds specific motorist obligations around bicycles, including a four-foot passing distance and door-opening fines, which were not in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "You must stay at least four feet away when passing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers and passengers can be fined up to $100 for opening a vehicle door into an oncoming bicycle." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: The Dutch Reach / Danger of Open Doors
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces the Dutch Reach method for opening vehicle doors to protect bicyclists, a concept absent from the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Open the door with your far hand (the hand farther from the door). This is called the \"Dutch Reach\" method because it originated in the Netherlands." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Bicycle Boxes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section on bicycle boxes and two-stage left turns, which do not appear in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Bicycle boxes are pavement markings that are installed at intersections to allow bicyclists a safe way to turn when approaching a red light." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Drivers must stop behind the bicycle box (even when it's empty) and wait for a green light." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Separated Bicycle Lanes
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section on separated bicycle lanes (cycle tracks/protected bike lanes), which is not in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Separated bicycle lanes, also know as cycle tracks and protected bike lanes, physically separate bicycle traffic from vehicular traffic." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Move-Over Law for Stationary Emergency Vehicles
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds the move-over law (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requiring drivers to change lanes away from stopped emergency vehicles, which is not present in the 2004 manual's handling of emergency vehicles.
bullets: "The \"move-over law\" (Chapter 418 of the Acts of 2008) requires you to be cautious and reduce your speed to a speed that is reasonable and safe for the road conditions when you approach a stationary emergency vehicle with flashing lights." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"On a highway with at least four lanes (at least two in the same direction you are heading), yield the right-of way by safely \"moving over\" to a lane that is not next to the lane the emergency vehicle is in." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Fine for Failure to Produce License or Registration
sections.description: The 2026 manual introduces a specific fine for failing to produce a license or registration during a traffic stop, which was not present in 2004.
bullets: "There is a $35 fine for a first offense for the failure to produce either document." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driving Through Tunnels
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds an entirely new section on tunnel safety procedures that does not exist in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Public Safety is a priority at MassDOT. Please follow these important safety tips when traveling through our tunnels." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"Hazardous Materials are prohibited, including propane." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Drive Smart and Save - Green Driving Tips
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds a new section on fuel efficiency and green driving practices not present in 2004.
bullets: "Fuel consumption increases about five percent for every five miles per hour driven above 60 mph." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Idling gets you zero miles per gallon. So when you're stopped, switch off the engine. It saves you fuel, and it's the law – Massachusetts state law prohibits idling for more than five minutes." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Leaving the Scene Penalties
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds detailed maximum penalties for leaving the scene of a crash, including specific fines and imprisonment terms, where the 2004 manual only referenced a hit-and-run violation generally.
bullets: "Up to $5000 and imprisonment of up to 2 ½ years in jail or up to 10 years in state prison for leaving the scene after a crash causing personal injury to any person that resulted in death (Section 2 (a ½) (2))" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

"Up to $1000 and imprisonment of up to two years for leaving the scene after a crash causing personal injury to any person (not resulting in death) (Section 2 (a ½) (1))" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Driver Removal Law
sections.description: The 2026 manual references the Driver Removal Law requiring vehicles to be moved out of travel lanes after a crash with no injuries, which is not in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "If there are no injuries, the Driver Removal Law requires that vehicles be moved out of travel lanes to a safe location." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Breakdown Safety Equipment Procedures
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds detailed safety vest, warning triangle, and LED flare placement instructions for breakdowns that were not specified in the 2004 manual.
bullets: "Locate your safety vest and warning triangles or LED flares (if you have them)." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
"If you stop on a two-lane road carrying traffic in both directions or on an undivided highway, place your warning triangles or LED flares:" (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Emergency Notification System for Stalled Vehicles on Tracks
sections.description: The 2026 manual adds instructions to call the Emergency Notification System (ENS) number and provide the DOT grade crossing locator number when stalled on tracks, replacing the 2004 instruction to simply call the police.
bullets: "If you cannot move your vehicle from the tracks, call the toll free Emergency Notification System (ENS) number that is located in the middle of the crossbuck or on the metal box near the grade crossing." (2026 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Salvage Repairable Title
sections.description: The 2004 manual's explanation of salvage/total loss vehicle titles is not present in the 2026 text provided.
bullets: "If your vehicle becomes inoperable due to fire, vandalism, collision, theft, flood, or another event to such an extent that you or, if insured, your insurer considers it uneconomical to repair the vehicle, the vehicle will be declared a total loss." (2004 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: Automotive Traffic Convention
sections.description: The 2004 manual's list of specific foreign countries whose visitors may drive on their own license is not present in the 2026 text, which instead refers generally to RMV-equivalent standards.
bullets: "A foreign visitor from one of the countries or territories listed here may legally drive on the roads of the Commonwealth on his or her own country's license" (2004 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)

sections.title: List of NATO Member Countries
sections.description: The 2004 manual's enumerated list of NATO member countries is not present in the 2026 text.
bullets: "Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Turkey, the United Kingdom, and the United States." (2004 Massachusetts Driver's Manual)
